title: Communities
subtitle: Find a place to play: community servers, their regular players and their links

errors.notFound: JKNet Online has no such community page.
errors.unauthorized: JKNet Online refused the session. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You cannot do that on this page.
errors.limit: A limit of JKNet Online stops this: {{message}}
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests to JKNet Online. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: JKNet Online did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
errors.conflict: JKNet Online could not apply that: {{message}}
errors.providerError: The game server did not answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.internal: JKNet Online has a problem of its own. Try again later.

catalog.noResultsHint: Pick another tag, clear the search or choose another language or region.
catalog.emptyHint: A community appears here once its owner confirms a server.

follow.promptText: Your subscriptions are kept in your JKNet Online account.

mine.signInTitle: Sign in to see your communities
mine.signInText: The communities you run as their owner or an editor are gathered here.
mine.emptyTitle: You do not run a community yet
mine.emptyText: Create a community for your server, or ask the owner of one to make you an editor.
mine.note: Communities where you are the owner or an editor, and the ones you created before confirming a server.
mine.noteAdmin: A JKNet administrator can edit any community. Here are the ones you created or run.

following.signInText: Follow communities to keep their pages one click away.
following.emptyTitle: You do not follow a community yet
following.emptyText: Follow a community from the catalog, and it appears here.
following.note: The bell turns the notifications of a community on or off.

create.title: Create community
create.body: A community starts with its first server. It appears in the catalog once you confirm that you run the server.
create.name: Name
create.addressHint: A public IPv4 address and port. If JKNet already knows the server, its community opens.
create.label: Server label
create.labelHint: Optional: what the page calls this server, such as Duel or RP. Up to 40 characters.
create.invalidAddress: Enter a public IPv4 address with a port, such as 203.0.113.15:29070.

page.notFound: The page does not exist or was removed.
page.shareFailed: The link could not be copied: {{link}}

about.title: About the community
about.empty: The organizers have not described the community yet.

play.title: Play
play.unverifiedHint: Only the organizers see this server until its code is checked.
play.noServers: The community has no public servers yet.
play.launcherNote: Join from the JKNet launcher: it installs the recommended files and connects in one click.

launcher.noClient: Create a client for {{game}} to play here.
launcher.running: Close the running game before installing or connecting.
launcher.stopped: Installation stopped. Completed files remain installed.
launcher.wrongGame: This file is for a different game.
launcher.conflicts: Some files already exist with different contents. Open the JKHub entry to review and replace them.
launcher.unsupported: This entry needs manual installation. Open its JKHub page.

discord.title: Discord · {{name}}
discord.widgetOffText: Players see the invite only. Turn the widget on, and the page shows the voice channels and the members online.
discord.path: In Discord: Server Settings, Widget, Enable Server Widget
discord.recheck: JKNet checks the widget again in 3 minutes.
discord.invalidText: The link expired or was deleted. Players do not see the Discord card until it is replaced.
discord.unavailable: Discord did not answer just now. The invite still works.

files.title: Recommended files
files.installInLauncher: The JKNet launcher installs them into a client in one click.

servers.organizerLead: Organizers also see the servers that are not verified yet.

claim.title: Is this your server?
claim.text: Confirm that you run it: put a code into its name, or ask a JKNet administrator to check.
claim.signIn: Sign in to claim the server
claim.codeHint: Temporarily add this code to sv_hostname, separated by spaces. Keep it there until verification finishes.
claim.pendingManual: Your request is awaiting administrator review. You do not need to change the server name.
claim.approved: Ownership confirmed. You can restore the original server name and edit this page.
claim.rejected: The request was declined. You can contact a JKNet administrator or request another verification.

players.lead: JKNet players who play on the community's servers regularly: {{count}}.
players.limit: The list shows the first {{shown}} of {{total}}.
players.privacy: Do not want to be on the list? Hide yourself in the settings.
players.privacyLauncher: A player hides themselves from the list in the settings of the JKNet launcher.

manage.title: Management
manage.soon: Servers, editors, tags, pictures and Discord get their own management screen in a later version. For now, edit the texts, links and recommended files of the page.

editor.title: Edit page
editor.name: Name
editor.taglineHint: One line under the name, up to 140 characters.
editor.descriptionHint: Markdown: lists, links and bold text, up to 6000 characters.
editor.discordHint: An invite link: discord.gg/code or discord.com/invite/code.
editor.filesHint: Add up to 30 JKHub file links. Their order is also the installation order.
editor.invalidFiles: Enter a title and a valid, distinct JKHub file link or ID for each recommendation.
editor.conflict: Someone changed the page meanwhile. Reload it and make your changes again.

privacy.title: Regular players of communities
privacy.toggle: Show me in the regular players of communities
privacy.text: Communities list the JKNet players who play on their servers regularly. Turning this off removes you from every list and deletes the playing time JKNet Online has counted.
privacy.unsupported: The JKNet Online service does not have this setting yet.
privacy.signedOut: Sign in to JKNet Online to choose whether communities list you.

site.title: Communities
site.intro: Find a community to play Jedi Academy and Jedi Outcast with: its servers, regular players and links.
site.signInHint: Complete sign-in in the opened tab, then return here.
site.loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
site.loginChoose: Choose how to sign in. A separate window will open.
site.loginCancelled: The sign-in window was closed. Choose a provider to try again.
site.loginBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Open it using the link below, or cancel and try again.
site.loginWindowHint: If you closed the sign-in window, try again or cancel.
